baselineDisplay.title: My Time in Junior High School
baselineDisplay.text: My time in junior high school has been enjoyable. In the first year, I didn't work very hard in class, but I joined many different school clubs and had a lot of fun. In Grade 8, I studied harder but I still got poor grades in English. I had problems with pronunciation and reading texts. So the next year, I worked much harder and got better grades. This year, with Mr. Trent's help, my English level has been improving and I hope to get good grades at the end of the year. Next year, I will be in senior high school. I can't believe how fast the time went by! When I get to senior high, I will join the school swim team.
